I understand your concern, and it's natural to feel worried given your own experience with Zoloft. Your child's response to any medication could be very different from yours, and there are many treatment options beyond Zoloft that a child psychiatrist or prescribing doctor can consider. Medication can be an important part of treatment, especially when suicidal thoughts are present, but this decision should be made with a qualified healthcare provider who can evaluate your child's specific needs.

Given that your child is experiencing suicidal thoughts, please reach out to their doctor or a mental health professional as soon as possible, or contact a crisis line if needed. You can call or text 988 in the US anytime. A professional can help you explore all options, including therapy, medication, or a combination, and monitor your child's safety. You're doing the right thing by seeking information and support.
